name: cashloom-sovereign
description: CashLoom sovereign node — non-custodial, local-first. Everyone pays everyone. One process, one file, your machine.

scripts.build:ui: cd ui && bun install && bun run build
scripts.test: bun run test:connectors && bun run test:node
scripts.test:connectors: bunx vitest run src/connectors src/utils src/info
scripts.test:node: bun test src/vault.test.ts src/sync.test.ts src/pay.test.ts src/senders/btc.sender.test.ts src/senders/evm.sender.test.ts src/zerone.test.ts && bun test src/pay/bitcoin-pay-link.test.ts && bun test src/pay/bitcoin-pay-link-router.test.ts && bun test src/senders/evm-nonce.test.ts && bun test src/senders/evm-nonce-migration.test.ts && bun test src/pay/agent-pay.test.ts && bun test src/pay/agent-pay-migration.test.ts && bun test src/processors/stripe-checkout.test.ts && bun test src/processors/stripe-checkout-migration.test.ts && bun run test:v2
scripts.test:v2: bun test src/protocol/v2/asset-trust.test.ts src/protocol/v2/bitcoin-profile.test.ts src/protocol/v2/service-trust.test.ts src/protocol/v2/service-trust-records.test.ts src/protocol/v2/records.test.ts src/protocol/v2/pay-link.test.ts src/protocol/v2/pay-link-acceptance.test.ts src/protocol/v2/node-authority.test.ts src/protocol/v2/record-store.test.ts src/protocol/v2/local-service.test.ts src/protocol/v2/pay-link-service.test.ts src/protocol/v2/transport.test.ts src/protocol/v2/router.test.ts src/protocol/v2/module-boundary.test.ts && bun test src/protocol/v2/schema-migration.test.ts && bun test src/protocol/v2/info-server-boundary.test.ts && bun test src/protocol/v2/index-integration.test.ts
